Context: 2. Conditions-

4. As the duties of Drivers are intermittent, no OTA is admissible if they are required to be on duty during lunch interval.
5. When a Driver is detained for duty at odd hours and has hardly any time left to rejoin duty in time after going home and finishing his meals, he may be granted the normal OTA, if the intervening period is less than 1 Yi hours. - Rules 26 to 28, Staff Car Rules.
